header: What you are looking at on a Tuesday morning
lead: One screen carries the whole week. These are the five places a duty manager actually uses.
caption: The week planner, Wednesday of a spring week at a three-till branch.

callouts.title: The day columns
callouts.text: Seven days across, staff down the side. Drag a shift anywhere and the checks run before it lands.

callouts.title: The rule strip
callouts.text: A red edge on a shift means a rule would break. Hover it and the rule is named in words, not in a code.

callouts.title: The budget line
callouts.text: Wage cost for the week so far against the branch target, updating as you plan.

callouts.title: The unfilled tray
callouts.text: Shifts nobody is on yet. Empty by Friday is the whole job.

callouts.title: The publish button
callouts.text: Greyed out until the week is legal. One press sends it to every phone.
